title: Celestial Nexus
problem: Checks Barrier/Shell on the creature that was hit, not the Nexus holder.
notes: Fix: S: swap the creature read 2026-10-26 build check: not a byte edit. bc_EventDamage L395 tests Barrier (6) / Shelled (13) on the hit creature BEFORE the holder loop (L396-L399: allies = bc_GetAlliesOf(creature); first ally with passive 1710 takes the hit), so the holder isn't known at the test. Hook spec: (1) make the L395 Barrier/Shell test always pass (redirect its two scr_CritHasCondition calls @0x140d4a435 / 0x140d4a634 to a stub returning true, or jump over the test); (2) replace the L398 scr_CritHasPassive(ally, 1710) call @0x140d4ab42 with a C hook that returns true only if the ally has 1710 AND (scr_CritHasCondition(ally, 6) or scr_CritHasCondition(ally, 13)). | In-game test: Nexus holder intercepts only while it has Barrier or Shell; with neither it does not intercept.

release_notes.intended: The holder takes hits for its allies while it has Barrier or Shell.
release_notes.actual: The game checked whether the creature being hit had Barrier or Shell, not the holder.
release_notes.fix: Now the holder's own Barrier or Shell decides whether it takes the hit.
